# Anxiety

## Short Definition
Persistent worry, threat anticipation, and avoidance of feared internal or external cues.

## Practical Description
The person experiences recurring worry and avoids cues that trigger distress.

## Typical Client Signals
- I worry about everything.
- I avoid situations that make me anxious.
